collection.title: Peugeot 306 Saloon 1993 to 1997 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Peugeot 306 1993 - 1997 model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
